inShort: B feeds from the kitchen, and A drips from the baseline: short backswing, long finish, low at the feet. 40 balls, then swap.
rules: A stands at the baseline. B stands at the kitchen line and feeds balls like a return. Put one shoe down the line and one cross-court, each about 2 m behind the kitchen line.
Short backswing like a dink. Let the ball meet the paddle, then accelerate through like a drive.
10 balls down the line, 10 cross-court, then the same on the backhand: 40 balls.
The drip clears the net low and is below net height when it reaches the shoe. Count the good ones per set of 10.
tooEasy: 7 of 10 per set reach the shoe below net height. Even harder: take every ball early, right after the bounce, with the feet set.
tooHard: B stands still and feeds the same ball, and the target is the whole transition zone, not the shoe.
goodLooksLike: The ball crosses the net low and dips at the shoe, and A's backswing is short but the finish long.

drill.title: Third-Shot Drip (Reps → Steal Time → Mix & Drip)
